truths.truth: After a start the playhead stands exactly one delay behind the line the stamps set, the same place it stands later in the track (SC1, AC3 as D-14 states it)
truths.evidence: hqptuner/static/model/gauges/playhead.js:118-126 standOnLine places a restart at aim = now + settled.ceiling - delay and otherwise follows that aim (followLine :229-234), capped at the newest end. tests/js/model/gauges/playhead-lag.test.js cases a_start_stands_one_delay_behind_the_line_* (lines 72-114), the_playhead_takes_a_rise_of_the_line_at_once_* (116-148) and the later-in-track cases the_playhead_moves_its_wall_time_on_a_line_that_holds / follows_a_rise_of_the_line_of_1_ms (166-247) assert exact playhead values with assert.equal. All pass in the verifier's one `scripts/gate.sh make check` run (exit=0 log=/tmp/gate-make-3uBIqmij.log, e.g. `ok 2208 - test_a_start_stands_one_delay_behind_the_line_when_the_paint_ran_at_the_arrival`, `ok 2217 - test_the_playhead_moves_its_wall_time_on_a_line_that_holds`).

truths.truth: Inputs identical but for the source rate give identical playheads (SC2, AC4 as D-12 (1) and D-14 state it)
truths.evidence: The rate enters only at the feed: hqptuner/static/store/meter/feed.js:113-128 decode converts at, end and ms through one samplesToMs (lib/timebase.js:19) and stamps arrivedAt from feedClock.now(). PaintInput (playhead.js:38-55) has no rate field; pacePaint reads only at/end/ms/arrivedAt/break of each frame plus rate-free inputs. tests/js/store/meter/feed.test.js:341-355 holds 44100 and 48000 feeds of the same music to one table SAME_MUSIC_READ (at, ms, arrivedAt, break), passing in the gate log (`ok 4969`, `ok 4970`, `ok 4971`, including after a reconnect at another rate). The table omits `end`, which endOf reads first; `end` comes from the same samplesToMs call as `at`, the per-rate contiguity cases (feed.test.js:226) pin it, and a spot-check of samplesToMs gives [20,30,60,80] at both 44100 and 48000. The loop's `now` and the feed's `arrivedAt` are on the same Clock (app.js:126-127 hands the one clock to initMeterFeed and initMeterLoop).

truths.truth: docs/spec/timing.md states the owner-approved rule for how the lag is set after a start (AC2, superseded in its decision step by D-08)
truths.evidence: docs/spec/timing.md:27-31 (The two clocks) and :41 (Rule 1): the playhead stands one delay behind the line, the line is the greatest lead over a short span, it restarts at a break carried on from the newest frame's arrival and takes each rise of the line at once through the opening span; landed by 4cbb8b56 `docs(7-4): the playhead follows the stamps' line, spec text approved by the owner`. The code at playhead.js:5-13,118-126,199-234 implements that text. The commit-cites-report part of AC2 is superseded by D-08 (CONTEXT.md:21).

truths.truth: The loop hands each paint its wall time, its arrival flag and the line the last decision handed back, and clears the line on reset, so a paint that takes no arrival follows the line earlier paints saw
truths.evidence: hqptuner/static/store/meter/loop.js:205-220 passes now, arrived (takeArrivals returns whether any frame moved, :171-177) and line to pacePaint and stores d.line; reset() sets line = null (:128). tests/js/store/meter/loop.test.js:184-206 test_a_paint_that_takes_no_arrival_stands_one_delay_behind_the_line_the_earlier_paints_saw drives a 1 kHz feed through the real feed and loop on a fake clock and asserts the second paint's playhead; passes in the gate log (`ok 5011`). The Plan 1 report records it red against the pre-fix code (`at: 3620` against `at: 3634`); not re-run by the verifier. No debt markers in playhead.js, loop.js or loop.test.js; no test of the old rule remains (grep for exactly_its_wall_time, delay_behind_the_newest_end, landing_early_or_late, _largest_step over tests/ is empty).
